result.summary: Incident 06f82d36-1964-4186-aed3-4c7b9ab1a375 aggregates three sequential alerts on host 'socai2-flow-20261108-01' involving user 'flow-observer-20261108-01'. The sequence includes a successful account logon (2026-11-08T01:26:09), a PowerShell process start executing 'Get-LocalUser' (2026-11-08T01:26:29), and a successful outbound TCP connection to 198.51.100.88:443 (2026-11-08T01:26:49). All alerts are rated 'medium' severity. Prior analysis for all members flags them as 'needs_review' due to lack of authorization evidence and inability to distinguish between authorized operations and potential reconnaissance/exfiltration. No causal chain is proven; temporal proximity is noted but not confirmed as attack progression.
